summary: Frontend-only verification of the Bot Pulse strategy-chip deep-link feature. All 7 review-request test cases PASSED end-to-end. Chips render as <a> anchors with the correct hrefs (including the 'account=default' sentinel for the null/default profile), clicking a chip navigates to /bot-config, the URL query string is cleaned up via setSearchParams({replace:true}) within ~1s, the Strategy Presets section scrolls into view, and the matching preset card pulses green (ring-2 + animate-pulse) for ~2.5s before the classes are removed. Page refresh does NOT re-trigger the scroll/highlight. Regression checks confirm KRAKEN_SPOT (no strategy_label) renders zero chips and the WINNING filter on /trades still works.

test_evidence.auth: admin@trading.bot / admin123 login succeeded; /trades loaded with bot-pulse-panel and 7 rows
test_evidence.chips_rendered: 6 anchor chips: SCALPER (OnEquity), MEAN REVERSION (RoboForex), SNIPER (STARTRADER), AGGRESSIVE (VTMarkets), TREND RIDER (Default profile — account=default), FAST SCALP (Tauro Markets). KRAKEN_SPOT row has zero chips (correct — strategy_label null).

scalper_deeplink.initial_class_on_preset_card_scalper: …border-[#FFD700] bg-[#FFD700]/5 ring-2 ring-[#00FF41] animate-pulse (verified ring-2 + animate-pulse both present)
scalper_deeplink.class_after_3000ms: border-[#FFD700] bg-[#FFD700]/5 (ring-2 + animate-pulse removed, ACTIVE yellow border preserved)
scalper_deeplink.post_refresh_highlight: not re-triggered — preset-card-scalper class contains no ring-2 or animate-pulse

trend_rider_default_profile_deeplink.preset_card_class: ring-2 ring-[#00FF41] animate-pulse present on preset-card-trend_rider
trend_rider_default_profile_deeplink.account_scope_note: account=default correctly maps to null selectedAccountId (BotConfig.jsx L69), so the AccountScopeBar lands on the Default-profile scope with no per-account override selected.

test_evidence.regression_kraken_no_chip: KRAKEN_SPOT row has 0 chips matching [data-testid^='bot-pulse-strategy-'] — regression PASS.
test_evidence.regression_winning_filter: filter-winning testid present and clickable; trades table narrows (visible on screenshot: WIN RATE 73.33% / WINS 132 / OPEN 4). Row count on Bot Pulse remains 7 (< DROPDOWN_THRESHOLD=10) so chips render inline as expected.
test_evidence.console: No new errors from BotPulsePanel or BotConfig during navigation, click, refresh, or highlight-timer paths (only pre-existing benign warnings).

critical_code_review_comments: BotConfig.jsx L63-77 — deepLinkAppliedRef guards against re-running the consumption effect after the first mount. Correct — setSearchParams({replace:true}) clears the query but the second render's useEffect returns early because the ref is already true. Verified in the refresh test: URL stays clean and highlight does NOT re-trigger.

BotConfig.jsx L81-88 — the scroll+highlight effect fires whenever `presets.length` changes from 0 → N or `highlightPreset` changes. Timer is properly cleaned via `return () => clearTimeout(t)` so a fast unmount won't leak. 2500ms matches the review spec.

BotConfig.jsx L326 & L375 — `isHighlighted` toggles `ring-2 ring-[#00FF41] animate-pulse` on both built-in preset cards AND custom preset cards. This means a chip whose strategy_key is `custom:<id>` would still highlight correctly — nice symmetry, though no admin config exercises that path today.

BotPulsePanel.jsx L85-102 — chip is now a <Link>. The URLSearchParams builder correctly emits 'account=default' when item.account_id is falsy. Only concern (non-blocking): if the row is stale for some reason and item.strategy_key is null while strategy_label is truthy, the href would omit ?preset and BotConfig would just scroll without pulsing — that's a benign fallback, not a bug.

Suggestion (non-blocking): the Link uses `to={"/bot-config?..."}`. If the app ever moves to hash routing, this string form breaks. Consider `to={{ pathname: '/bot-config', search: params.toString() }}` for forward-compat, but not required today.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deep-link flow (Bot Pulse strategy chip → /bot-config?account=<id>&preset=<key>) is fully validated: chip renders as <a>, href builds correctly, click navigates, URL cleaned via setSearchParams replace, Strategy Presets section scrolled+pulsed for 2.5s, refresh does not re-trigger. Both real-account and default-profile (account=default sentinel) paths verified. Custom-preset (custom:<id>) highlight code path exists (BotConfig.jsx L375) but no admin config uses one — worth exercising once a user_preset is applied to a bot_config in a future iteration.
